openwatcom: <path to the OpenWatcom release tree (the folder holding binnt64/)>
powerpc_tools: <optional: folder of a PowerPC-targeting cl.exe and link.exe>
period_compiler: <optional: folder of a period 32-bit CL.EXE, for `match` and `repair`>
dosbox_x: <optional: dosbox-x.exe, for the DOS compilers and assemblers>

kits.msc203: <optional: folder holding MC1.EXE and MC2.EXE (Microsoft C 2.03)>
kits.xenix86: <optional: the XENIX C compiler's files (lib/c1, lib/c2 ...)>

masm: <optional: folder of a Microsoft Macro Assembler (BIN\MASM.EXE)>
nasm: <optional: nasm.exe of the nasm-masm project (a MASM-compatible NASM)>
xenix_c: <optional: folder holding xcc.py (the XENIX C compiler of Microsoft's 1984 tools), for `repair --truth`>
java: <optional: java.exe (JRE/JDK 8+), for decompiling a jar before transpiling; default JAVA_HOME / PATH>
retromcp: <optional: retromcp-cli.jar (RetroMCP-Java + Vineflower), turns a Minecraft version into Java source>
xbox360_sdk: <optional: the Xbox 360 SDK root; needed for the Java transpiler's xbox360 target>
host_cxx: <optional: full path to the C++ compiler that judges transpiled Java (g++.exe); default g++ on PATH>
msbuild: <optional: MSBuild.exe, to build a transpiled game's Visual Studio project>
java_overlays: <optional: folder of per-project hand fixes for transpiled Java; default state/java/overlays>
qemu: <optional: qemu-system-i386.exe, for the Windows 95 boot checks>
win95_installed_hd: <optional: raw image of a disk with Windows 95 installed, for `vxd boot` (read only)>
